messages:
jules: Heads-up: saw onboarding sampleapp cause a client-side overload when pagination + auth refresh coincide. Repro: start 12 page fetches then force token rotate. Results: inflight requests stall, then all retry -> 429s.

pat: Repro'd. JS SDK spins up pages without limit; refresh blocks but doesn't gate new launches.

mei: Py SDK uses single-flight refresh + queue, JS doesn't. We should pick consistent default.

jules: Quick mitigation: add maxParallelPages default=4 in sample config + small randomized delay after refresh before retrying.

pat: Also add AbortController wiring so queued tasks cancel on user stop.

ops-bot: Quota alert: sample-host-3 hit 429 spike at 2026-02-10T09:14Z.

sdk-oncall: Action items: PR for JS SDK to add authStrategy {queue|parallel}, sampleapp to set maxParallelPages and semaphore, docs note for onboarding.

mei: I'll add a tiny e2e smoke test simulating 500-row import to catch regressions.

jules: Cool. After fix, let's expose env vars RW_MAX_PARALLEL_PAGES and RW_AUTH_STRATEGY so ops can tune without code changes.

pat: Patch landed to staging (v0.5.2). Smoke test shows no 429s with maxParallelPages=4.

sdk-oncall: Will coordinate parity tickets for Go and Py.
